Properties Vehicles Classifieds Services Jobs Deals Post Ad Home News Events Article Doha Used Car Buying Guide: Prices, Tips & Paperwork Doha Used Car Buying Guide: Prices, Tips & Paperwork Jun 16, 2026 Looking for a Doha used car?
You can pick up a reliable second-hand vehicle in Qatar for as little as QAR 15,000–25,000 for an older sedan, or QAR 40,000–80,000 for a recent SUV in good shape, far less than buying new.

As a rough guide based on what you'll typically see across Qatar's classifieds, expect the following: Typical price ranges by category Budget runabout (older sedan, 2012–2016) — typically around QAR 12,000–25,000.
European / luxury used — typically QAR 60,000–250,000+ depending on age.

Before you hand over any cash, run through this checklist or take the car to a trusted garage in the Industrial Area for a paid inspection (typically around QAR 100–250): Air conditioning — non-negotiable in Doha.
For a reliable everyday car you'll generally spend QAR 25,000–50,000.
